name: Grok 4.7 Build Fast
note_long: Run 2 is the single most complete e-foil in the whole set: angled mast, fuselage, propeller, and a remote in hand. Runs 1 and 3 crop the penguin at the edge of the frame.

note.en: Run 2 is the most complete e-foil in the set.
note.ru: Прогон 2 — самый полный e-foil во всём наборе.
